steps.title: A gatehouse
steps.body: Assets are built from bricks in the Assets screen. Three helpers above the build plate make it faster: a mirror, Fill and Stamp. Then any part can become a door, a drawbridge or a lever in one click.
steps.task: Make a new asset called Gatehouse.

how.text: Assets › New asset, then type Gatehouse as its Name (Brix's helper does both).

do.say: Gatehouse, open on its build plate.

steps.title: Both sides at once
steps.body: ⇆ Mirror X copies everything you do to the other side of a blue line across the plate: each brick you place, paint or erase. − and + move the line half a stud.
steps.task: Turn on Mirror X and place three bricks: six go down.

how.text: Click “⇆ Mirror X” above the build plate. A blue line crosses the plate.
Pick the Place tool (B) and click the plate beside the line, three times.

do.say: Three bricks, and their mirror images.

steps.title: Copy and stamp
steps.body: ⧉ Stamp (or Ctrl C, then Ctrl V) copies the selected bricks; each click of the Place tool puts another copy down, going up until it fits. Escape stops.
steps.task: Copy the whole build and stamp a second one beside it.

how.text: Select every brick (drag a box, or Shift+click), press “⧉ Stamp”, then click the plate beside the build.

do.say: A second copy, stamped beside the first.

steps.title: A drawbridge
steps.body: Select the bricks that move and pick a kind in “Selected bricks → a door, a drawbridge…”. The asset gets two states, the part its hinge and pose, and E opens and closes it in Play. Pick a state above the plate to see it.
steps.task: Make the stamped copy a drawbridge.

how.text: Select the stamped bricks, then pick “Drawbridge” in “Selected bricks → a door, a drawbridge…”.

do.say: A drawbridge: up when closed, down when open.

steps.title: Turn it into
steps.body: Turn it into makes the asset breakable, pushable (loose: it falls, tips over and floats) or a creature that walks wearing its bricks, each in one click.

how.text: Under Turn it into, click “📦 Pushable”.

steps.title: You can build faster
steps.body: Mirror, Fill and Stamp are above every build plate; moving parts and Turn it into are in the asset's panel. Brix's Help has each of them (search “mirror”, “stamp”, “drawbridge”).
